text: Toronto Atmospheric Fund uses several performance indicators to inform and maximize the impact of our programs, grants, investments, policy advocacy and communications. The 2023 Impact Report summarizes Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s results and complements the 2023 Results Report (received by the Board at its meeting of February 12, 2024) which summarizes the activities and accomplishments against the Annual Plan, and the 2023 Audited Financial Statements which presents Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s financial results (see Item TA 6.1).
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Received the report (April 12, 2024) from the Vice President, Strategy and Partnerships, Toronto Atmospheric Fund for information.
